rulings.ruling: Adopt the printed Starships of the Galaxy Table 3-7 base prices (stygium cloaking device 100,000,000; hangar bay 10; concealed hangar bay 1,000). Preserve previous catalog values in discrepancy history.

A printed dash in an ammunition EP column is not numeric zero. Such rows are consumable ammunition acquired and loaded into a compatible launcher, not separately installed ship modifications. No invented EP. Launcher compatibility, quantity, loading and firing stay gated pending mechanical certification.
